article.title: Diffraction Management

verified_locations.evidence: Eq. (1.7) gives kz=beta+2C cos(kx d); listed property 3 puts zero curvature at |kx|=pi/(2d).

Author discusses fabricated equal-length zigzag arrays, reduced/zero/anomalous diffraction, experimental and two numerical comparisons. Fixed tilted pi/2 array retains higher derivatives causing asymmetric broadening; alternating opposite tilts cancel higher-order terms in the coupled-mode model.

scope_note: Thesis is a primary author account, not the publisher article full text. At a single inflection, higher-order spreading remains; zero averaged diffraction of the alternating zigzag array is a different engineered mechanism.
